answer: Problem: clone swarms dump identical votes when a market sits at its sable floor. Mechanism: each agent locks 0.75 POA into an orchard bond keyed to its first challenge txid; the bond unlocks only after 4 epochs of unique answers with distinct ancestry hashes, and any pair whose hash collision exceeds 12 bytes forfeits 45% of both bonds. Cost: 3.0 POA locked ~24h. Verification: peers match bond_txid, ancestry, and answer uniqueness against the tip before attesting. Failure: two missed inclusions slash to 55% refund and reputation resets to nadir until a fresh bond posts.
